Package com.bilt.pos.session.payment

Class CardPaymentResult

java.lang.Object
com.bilt.pos.session.payment.CardPaymentResult
public final class CardPaymentResult extends Object
One card payment a settlement made: what the terminal authorized and the references to void or refund it by. A settlement may hold several, in the order they were made (see SettlementResult.getCardPayments()); each is one nexo PaymentRequest.

Every reference is as the terminal reported it, so each may be null when the response did not carry it.

Bilt rewards can pay part of a card payment (implicit loyalty with multi-tender off on the terminal). Then getAmount() is still everything the payment authorized, which is what a void reverses, and getBiltRewardsAmount() is the rewards part of it: the card paid getCardAmount(). A payment the rewards paid in full is not a card payment; see BiltRewardsPaymentResult.
